document.lead: You should spend about 20 minutes on this task.

chart.alt: Two maps of a university campus, now (top) and planned for 2030 (bottom); north is at the top. Now: a sports field across the north; a car park in the west; a library with a café below it in the centre; lecture halls in the east; the main gate in the south with a lawn to its east; Campus Road runs along the southern edge. Planned for 2030: an indoor sports centre on the western half of the sports field, the field keeps its eastern half; the car park is cut to about half its size and student housing is built on the rest; the library, café and lecture halls are unchanged; the lawn becomes bike parking; a new bus stop on Campus Road to the west of the main gate.
